scope: Editor C++ builds BlendSpace1D, additive Aim Offset for two bipeds, layered AnimBP and montages; first UE5.8 build and visual validation remain pending.

variables.Speed: float, horizontal velocity magnitude in cm/s
variables.Direction: float, signed movement angle in degrees relative to actor forward
variables.AimYaw: float, local camera/target yaw in degrees
variables.AimPitch: float, local camera/target pitch in degrees
variables.WorkState: enum driven by replicated gameplay state
variables.FootIKEnabled: bool, false for distant LODs or non-footed rigs

phase_selector.state: LocomotionPhase (0 ground, 1 jump start, 2 fall loop, 3 land)
